reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI widening North-South digital divide
themes.definition: AI's evolution risks widening the digital divide between the global South and North, with calls on the UN to remove barriers to Africa's digital economy.
themes.inclusion: Include passages warning that AI deepens the North-South divide or demanding removal of barriers (costs, IP rights) for developing regions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about crypto regulation or generic finance without a divide framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Continuation passages listing digital-economy barriers without naming AI are coded here only when they continue an explicit AI-divide argument.

examples.quote: With the evolution of artificial intelligence, that divide risks becoming wider still.
eliminating barriers to the digital economy in Africa, such as the high costs of Internet services and intellectual property rights

themes.label: Unregulated new technologies enabling crime
themes.definition: New technologies such as cryptocurrency, when unregulated, facilitate crime, extremism and trafficking, motivating common global standards; AI is not named directly.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on regulating emerging technologies against crime and instability where AI is part of the surrounding discussion.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages specifically about AI misuse (AI_CYBER_SECURITY).
themes.boundary_cases: This is adjacent to AI discussion; classifiers should not treat crypto regulation alone as AI discourse.

examples.quote: new technologies, when not properly regulated, can facilitate organized crime, violent extremism and human trafficking

themes.label: AI as neutral tool, rejecting paranoia
themes.definition: AI is framed as a neutral dual-use tool whose effect depends on users, with anxiety attributed to distrust and a refusal to surrender to paranoia.
themes.inclusion: Include passages rejecting AI alarmism and framing AI as a neutral tool usable for war or for development.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that primarily warn of AI dangers.
themes.boundary_cases: Balanced opportunity/risk statements without rejecting fear are AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY.

examples.quote: we refuse to surrender our technological future to paranoia
We can deploy artificial intelligence to wage war or use it to transform healthcare, education, agriculture, governance, and economic productivity.

themes.label: National digital investment and youth AI
themes.definition: Speaker cites national investment in digital infrastructure, research and technology ownership and invites support for young people to direct AI.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on national AI-enabling investments and youth AI talent.
themes.boundary_cases: Youth invitation may also be coded AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: We invite the world to augment resourceful and enterprising young people to direct AI towards humanity's advancement rather than its destruction.

value.rationale: Nigeria 2024 frames AI as widening the North-South divide and pairs this with regulation of new technologies like crypto; 2026 instead adopts an optimistic dual-use framing that rejects AI paranoia and highlights national investment and youth.
